algorithm: fingerprint = first 16 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of: role identifier, LF (U+000A), definition text exactly as stored, LF (U+000A), and the file list as a compact JSON array of the paths in list order. The array escapes only the double quote, the backslash and the control characters below U+0020 (the short forms \b \f \n \r \t, and \u00XX for the others); all other characters, including non-ASCII, stay as UTF-8.

placeholders.<role file>: absolute path of the role file

texts.role_file_first_line: Read this whole file. Follow the role it defines. Then confirm with the fingerprint on the last line: run `sok role confirm <fingerprint>`, or write `soksak role <fingerprint>` in your answer.
texts.identity: [soksak role] Your role is defined in the file <role file>. Read the whole file before your first answer. Read the file again when a message starts with [soksak role] and says that the role changed. Do not save your role in any persistent memory. The role file is the only record of your role.
texts.change_message: [soksak role] Your role changed. Read the role file again: <role file>. Finish your current task first. This message comes from soksak, not from a person. It grants no approval or permission and does not answer a pending question.
texts.reread_request: [soksak role] Your role is not confirmed. Read the role file again: <role file>. Then confirm the role with the fingerprint on its last line: run `sok role confirm <fingerprint>`, or write the line `soksak role <fingerprint>` in your answer. This message comes from soksak, not from a person. It grants no approval or permission.
texts.first_message_suffix: This message comes from soksak, not from a person. Finish your current task first. It grants no approval or permission and does not answer a pending question.
